#Create counts_batch_corrected_combined
##Load batch corrected datasets
```{r}
#filtered_counts_field <- read.csv("data/batch_mad_filtered_field.csv",row.names=1, check.names = FALSE)
dim(batch_corrected_field)
#filtered_counts_lab <- read.csv("data/batch_mad_filtered_lab.csv",row.names=1, check.names = FALSE)
dim(batch_corrected_lab)

#Store as a data frame so they won't be "coherced into a list"
batch_corrected_field <- as.data.frame(batch_corrected_field)
batch_corrected_lab <- as.data.frame(batch_corrected_lab)
```


##Create a column called ofav_gene so that daatasets may be combiend.
```{r}
#Creating column called ofav_gene
##field
batch_corrected_field$ofav_gene <- rownames(batch_corrected_field)
dim(batch_corrected_field)

names(batch_corrected_field)

##lab
batch_corrected_lab$ofav_gene <- rownames(batch_corrected_lab)
dim(batch_corrected_lab)

names(batch_corrected_lab)
```


##Combine datasets with inner_join so that only shared genes are kept
```{r}
counts_batch_corrected_combined <- batch_corrected_lab %>% inner_join(batch_corrected_field, by = "ofav_gene")

dim(counts_batch_corrected_combined)
counts_batch_corrected_combined <- as.data.frame(counts_batch_corrected_combined)
names(counts_batch_corrected_combined)

#Format the values in the ofav_gene column (the gene names) into the row names
rownames(counts_batch_corrected_combined)<- counts_batch_corrected_combined$ofav_gene 
dim(counts_batch_corrected_combined)
names(counts_batch_corrected_combined)


#Remove the now extra ofav_gene column (the column is still present eventhough ofav_gene are now the row names)
counts_batch_corrected_combined<- counts_batch_corrected_combined %>% dplyr::select(-"ofav_gene") #eliminate column after using it for rownames
names(counts_batch_corrected_combined)
```

#Create filtered_meta_combined
##Load filtered metadata
```{r}
#filtered_meta_field <- read.csv("data/filtered_meta_field.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
dim(filtered_meta_field)
#filtered_meta_lab <- read.csv("data/filtered_meta_lab.csv", row.names = 2, check.names = FALSE)
dim(filtered_meta_lab)
```


##Add sample_ID column
```{r}
#Field
filtered_meta_field$sample_ID <- rownames(filtered_meta_field)
dim(filtered_meta_field)
names(filtered_meta_field)

#LabID
filtered_meta_lab$sample_ID <- rownames(filtered_meta_lab)
dim(filtered_meta_lab)
names(filtered_meta_lab)
```



#Use the sample_ID column to combine the metadata
```{r}
#only samples shared between the two data sets are kept
filtered_meta_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(filtered_meta_lab, filtered_meta_field)
dim(filtered_meta_combined)
filtered_meta_combined <- as.data.frame(filtered_meta_combined) # save as dataframe

#format metadata so that sample_ID are the rownames
rownames(filtered_meta_combined) <- filtered_meta_combined$sample_ID
dim(filtered_meta_combined)
names(filtered_meta_combined)


#Remove the now extra sample_ID column 
filtered_meta_combined <- filtered_meta_combined %>% dplyr::select(-sample_ID)
names(filtered_meta_combined)
dim(filtered_meta_combined)

#Remove column one
filtered_meta_combined <- filtered_meta_combined %>% dplyr::select(-'...1')
names(filtered_meta_combined)
dim(filtered_meta_combined)
```


#Make sure the data lines up between filtered counts and filtered meta
```{r}
# Check if all sample IDs in count data are in the metadata
all(colnames(counts_batch_corrected_combined) %in% rownames(filtered_meta_combined))  # Should be TRUE

# Check if their order matches
all(colnames(counts_batch_corrected_combined) == rownames(filtered_meta_combined))  # Ideally TRUE
```


#Add columns needed in metadata for MINT Analysis
```{r}
#Add a status column
filtered_meta_combined <- filtered_meta_combined %>%
  mutate( #creates new columns with the following components
    status = case_when(
      Final_State == "Diseased" ~ "affected",
      SCTLD_RNA == "SCTLD_affected" ~"affected",
      Final_State == "Healthy" ~ "unaffected",
      SCTLD_RNA == "SCTLD_unaffected" ~"unaffected",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) # fallback for unexpected combinations

#Add a data column
filtered_meta_combined <- filtered_meta_combined %>%
  mutate( #creates new columns with the following components
    data = case_when(
      SP3 == "TRUE" ~ "RRC",
      Real_timepoint.x == "Pre_Early_Exposure" ~"Mote_CIL",
      Real_timepoint.x == "Early_Exposure" ~ "Mote_CIL",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) # fallback for unexpected combinations


#Add status_data column
filtered_meta_combined <- filtered_meta_combined %>%
  mutate( #creates new columns with the following components
    status_data = case_when(
      status == "affected" & data == "Mote_CIL" ~ "affected_lab",
      status == "affected" & data == "RRC" ~ "affected_field",
      status == "unaffected" & data == "Mote_CIL" ~ "unaffected_lab",
      status == "unaffected" & data == "RRC" ~ "unaffected_field",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) # fallback for unexpected combinations


#Add a gene_name column to filtered_meta_combined!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!1
##Multiple genes correlate to each sample, so this doesn't make sense??
filtered_meta_combined$gene_name <- rownames(counts_batch_corrected_combined)[
  match(rownames(filtered_meta_combined), colnames(counts_batch_corrected_combined))]
```

#Create filtered_counts_combined for DESeq2/PCA Analysis
##filtered datasets
```{r}
dim(filtered_counts_field)
dim(filtered_counts_lab)

#Store as a data frame so they won't be "coherced into a list"
filtered_counts_field <- as.data.frame(filtered_counts_field)
filtered_counts_lab <- as.data.frame(filtered_counts_lab)
```


##Create a column called ofav_gene so that daatasets may be combiend.
```{r}
#Creating column called ofav_gene
##field
filtered_counts_field$ofav_gene <- rownames(filtered_counts_field)
dim(filtered_counts_field)

names(filtered_counts_field)

##lab
filtered_counts_lab$ofav_gene <- rownames(filtered_counts_lab)
dim(filtered_counts_lab)

names(filtered_counts_lab)
```


##Combine datasets with inner_join so that only shared genes are kept
```{r}
counts_combined <- filtered_counts_lab %>% inner_join(filtered_counts_field, by = "ofav_gene")

dim(counts_combined)
counts_combined <- as.data.frame(counts_combined)
names(counts_combined)

#Format the values in the ofav_gene column (the gene names) into the row names
rownames(counts_combined)<- counts_combined$ofav_gene 
dim(counts_combined)
names(counts_combined)


#Remove the now extra ofav_gene column (the column is still present eventhough ofav_gene are now the row names)
counts_combined<- counts_combined %>% dplyr::select(-"ofav_gene") #eliminate column after using it for rownames
names(counts_combined)
```


##Create PCA of combined data
###Create DESeq2 Model
```{r}
dds_combined <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_combined,
  colData = filtered_meta_combined,
  design = ~ 0 + status_data)

dds_combined <- DESeq(dds_combined)

resultsNames(dds_combined)

res_combined_field <- results(dds_combined, contrast = c("status_data", "affected_field","unaffected_field"))

summary(res_combined_field)

res_combined_lab <- results(dds_combined, contrast = c("status_data", "affected_lab","unaffected_lab"))

summary(res_combined_lab)


#Check how many DEGs remain after removing location and SVs
print(res_combined_field)
print(res_combined_lab)

sig_combined_field <- as.data.frame(res_combined_field)
w <- sig_combined_field %>% filter(padj<0.1)
print(w) #Only has 1 significantly differentially expressed gene?????!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

sig_combined_lab <- as.data.frame(res_combined_lab)
q <- sig_combined_lab %>% filter(padj<0.1)
print(q)
```


###Normalize with vst for PCA
```{r}
vsd_combined <- vst(dds_combined, blind = FALSE) #blind = FALSE takes into model consideration
```


###PCA Plot
```{r}
#VST of vsd_field before batch correction
vst_counts_combined <- assay(vsd_combined)

#PCA on filtered combined counts
pca_combined <- prcomp(t(vst_counts_combined), scale. = FALSE)

#Variance explained
percentVar <- round(
  100 * (pca_combined$sdev^2 / sum(pca_combined$sdev^2)))[1:2]

#Build PCA df
pca_df_combined <- as.data.frame(pca_combined$x)
pca_df_combined$sample <- rownames(pca_df_combined)

pca_df_combined$status_data <- filtered_meta_combined$status_data[
  match(pca_df_combined$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_combined))]


# Plot
ggplot(pca_df_combined, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = status_data)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "unaffected_field" = "lightgreen",
    "affected_field" = "darkgreen",
    "unaffected_lab" = "lightblue",
    "affected_lab" = "darkblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Filtered Combined Counts (No Batch Correction)",
    subtitle = "All filtered genes used (VST, blind = FALSE)",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
```
